target_customer: Freelancers and small online sellers in Indian metro and tier-2 cities who file GST or income tax themselves and worry about mistakes.
competitors: Established CA firms and tax-filing portals such as ClearTax (unverified, from general knowledge)
Individual local chartered accountants charging per filing (unverified)
Doing it yourself on the government portals
failure_reasons: Customers stay with the accountant they already know and trust.
Filing season is short, so a slow start can leave months of fixed cost with no revenue.
One filing error damages trust and referrals quickly.

compliance_flags.note: Tax filing advice may need to be signed off by a qualified chartered accountant; the partner arrangement should be checked. Verify with official sources; this is not legal advice.
Storing identity and financial documents falls under India's data protection rules. Verify with official sources; this is not legal advice.
The service itself has GST registration and invoicing implications. Verify with official sources; this is not legal advice.

market_saturation.justification: Many CAs and portals exist, but freelancers are under-served by flat-fee plans.

operational_complexity.justification: A partner accountant does the filings; the founder runs onboarding and support.

compliance.justification: Professional-services and data-handling rules need checking but are manageable with a partner.

capital_need.justification: Software is simple and the partner is paid per filing.

founder_load.justification: Sales and support fall on one founder during filing season.

suggested_pivots: Start with GST filing for online sellers only, where demand is clearest.
Offer a free filing-readiness checklist to collect leads before selling plans.
